title: Senior Frontend Architect & Team Leader
description:
Extensive experience across multiple software development areas: from server management, databases, and systems administration to UI design and full-stack web application engineering, where I focus my core technical work.

Collaborative team player, problem-solver, committed to clean code and the rigorous application of best practices.
jsSkill: Advanced and comprehensive mastery of the language through key concepts such as closures, prototypes, event loop, promises, async/await, memory management, modules, and execution context.
tsSkill: Advanced level focused on strict typing, generics, utility types, scalable interfaces, and decorators. Ability to design large-scale architectures ensuring robustness, type safety, and ease of refactoring.
fpSkill: Application of advanced functional principles such as immutability, pure functions, currying, higher-order functions, and composition. Structured approach to declarative data flows, minimizing side effects.
reactSkill: Solid expertise in building functional components, lifecycle and state management using hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback), conditional rendering, performance optimization, and reusable UI architectures.
reduxSkill: Centralized and predictable global state management. Handling of complex asynchronous data flows, implementation of reducers, middlewares, memoized selectors, and context providers to avoid prop drilling.
emberSkill: Expert level in the framework's complete ecosystem. Deep understanding of advanced routing, services, adapters, Ember Data serializers, component lifecycle, and application of the convention-over-configuration philosophy.
nextjsSkill: Solid knowledge in rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR), file-system-based routing, image optimization, client-side hydration, and deployment of high-performance universal web applications.
primereactSkill: Experience in integrating and customizing this UI component suite. Handling of complex data tables, filtering, pagination, form validation, and theme configuration to build robust enterprise interfaces.
jquerySkill: Absolute mastery in direct DOM manipulation, advanced event management, animation handling, and AJAX request integration. Solid experience in optimizing and scalably maintaining legacy codebases.
angularjsSkill: Solid knowledge of the framework's classic MVC architecture, implementing two-way data binding, custom directives, dependency injection, service definition, and digest cycle control.
angularSkill: Fundamental knowledge in the modern framework, covering the creation and structuring of components, modules, and services, use of structural directives, and basic routing system configuration.
riotSkill: Experience in developing minimalist and fast-loading interfaces by creating custom tags, applying lightweight reactivity, and elegant syntax in micro-component-based architectures.
requirejsSkill: Implementation of AMD (Asynchronous Module Definition) patterns for asynchronous dependency loading, source code modularization, and performance optimization in architectures prior to native ES6 standards.
coffeeSkill: Fluent mastery in writing concise and expressive code, deep understanding of its compilation to standard JavaScript, class management, and lexical contexts in architectures that heavily adopted this language.
bootstrapSkill: Comprehensive mastery of the framework for rapid UI prototyping with a Mobile First approach. Extensive use of the flexible grid system, advanced variable customization via SCSS, and structural adaptation of pre-built components.
foundationSkill: Solid handling of the responsive framework, implementing its semantic column system, accessibility-oriented components, and modular configuration to ensure a consistent visual design adaptable to any device.
htmlSkill: Expert level in semantic markup (HTML5), logical and hierarchical content structuring, strict compliance with accessibility standards (WCAG, ARIA), and DOM optimization to favor technical SEO and assistive technologies.
cssSkill: Advanced knowledge of CSS3, modular architectures (BEM), layout modeling with Flexbox and CSS Grid, use of Custom Properties (native variables), fluid animations, and precise techniques for responsive design.
lessSkill: Expert use as a preprocessor for structuring modular stylesheets. Extensive knowledge in implementing variables, mixins, structural nesting, and mathematical functions to maintain clean codebases.
sassSkill: Absolute mastery in designing scalable architecture using SCSS. Advanced use of control directives, selective inheritance, dynamic mixins, and custom functions to orchestrate robust design systems.
gruntSkill: Frontend workflow automation using declarative configurations. Proven ability to orchestrate asset compilation tasks, source code minification, linting processes, and overall asset optimization.
gulpSkill: Advanced configuration of high-performance build pipelines based on in-memory streams. Extensive experience chaining asynchronous processes for styling, scripting, and deployment environment preparation.
webpackSkill: Fundamental knowledge in module bundling, understanding the inner workings of the dependency graph, and ability to operate with basic loaders and structural plugins of the ecosystem.
d3Skill: High level in creating complex and interactive data visualizations, rendering dynamic SVG graphics through the deep use of scales, vector axes, transitions, physical force layouts, and hierarchical structures.
konvaSkill: Advanced ability in exploiting the HTML5 Canvas API to build high-performance interactive graphics and animations. Direct work on node hierarchies, overlapping layers, user events, and vector drawing.
jasmineSkill: Development and maintenance of unit tests implementing a BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) approach. Writing clear specifications, logical assertions, and using spies to validate functional code behavior.
jestSkill: Solid implementation of code coverage through unit and integration testing. Advanced use of the assertion engine, dependency and module mocking, snapshot testing, and business logic regression prevention.
mochaSkill: Fundamental knowledge for structuring and executing asynchronous test suites in JavaScript environments, usually in conjunction with external libraries dedicated to assertions and mocking (such as Chai and Sinon).
nodejsSkill: Development of event-driven asynchronous backend services, workflow automation scripts (pipelines), and internal 3D rendering tooling managing intensive I/O operations.
nestjsSkill: Robust backend architecture through dependency injection and modularity, scalable RESTful API creation, middleware handling, guards, interceptors, and efficient database connection.
expressSkill: Fundamental configuration of HTTP servers in Node.js, creation of basic REST routes, request/response management, and middleware coupling for lightweight web applications.
phpSkill: Extensive full-stack experience in the development and maintenance of transactional web portals, e-commerce, external API integration, classic MVC architectures, and proprietary CMS development.
symfonySkill: Fundamental knowledge of the modern enterprise PHP framework, covering bundle structuring, routing system, controllers, and dependency management using Composer.
twigSkill: Absolute mastery of the PHP template engine, semantic view structuring, template inheritance, macros, and filters to efficiently decouple presentation logic from the backend.
bladeSkill: Advanced use of Laravel's templating system, component injection, conditional directives, and master layouts to generate dynamic and maintainable views in modern web applications.
smartySkill: Consolidated experience in managing and implementing this template engine in legacy projects, facilitating safe data interpolation and visual layer organization in traditional PHP architectures.
sqlSkill: Advanced level in relational schema design, complex queries, joins, subqueries, index optimization, stored procedures, and referential integrity in transactional production environments.
solrSkill: Integration and querying of Lucene-based enterprise search engines, configuration of structured indexing schemas, faceted search, tokenization, and results relevance optimization.
elasticsearchSkill: Fundamental knowledge of the distributed search and analytics engine, JSON document indexing, and RESTful query structuring for fast retrieval of complex data.
linuxSkill: Native use and administration of UNIX-based systems, automation through Shell scripting (Bash), server management, deployment environment configuration, and fluent command-line tooling.
macosSkill: Primary development environment, mastery of the Apple ecosystem for efficient workflow management, setup of developer tools (Homebrew, custom terminals), and cross-platform testing.
windowsSkill: Expert knowledge of the operating system at an administration level, network configuration, virtualized development environments (WSL2), technical user support, and integration with cross-platform workflows.
githubSkill: Advanced mastery of distributed version control, complex conflict resolution, branch protection policies, thorough code reviews via Pull Requests, and branching strategy structuring.
mercurialSkill: Solid experience in decentralized repository management and revision control during corporate development stages, facilitating parallel workflows and source code traceability.
npmSkill: Expert knowledge in dependency tree resolution, private package publishing, lifecycle script execution, security auditing, and efficient management of the JavaScript ecosystem.
bowerSkill: Fundamental handling of the legacy front-end dependency manager, widely used for integrating flat libraries, frameworks, and static assets in traditional web architectures.
composerSkill: Functional use for installing, updating, and autoloading libraries and components within the PHP ecosystem, ensuring package compatibility across backend architectures.
rxjsSkill: Integration of reactive programming for advanced event handling and asynchronous data streams on the client side, utilizing observables, transformation operators, and cancellation strategies.
analyticsSkill: Technical implementation and strategic configuration of web analytics for e-commerce and high-traffic portals, through the structured injection of data layers, tags, variables, and custom triggers.
dockerSkill: Agile deployment via service containerization, basic orchestration with Docker Compose, custom image creation, and environment isolation to standardize workflows from development to production.
awsSkill: Operation and deployment on cloud infrastructure, including static storage, provisioning of scalable elastic compute servers, and serverless function orchestration.
swaggerSkill: Interactive documentation and technical standardization under OpenAPI, enabling the generation of robust client-server contracts, endpoint validation, and easing RESTful API integration.
xsltSkill: Solid knowledge in the transformation, restructuring, and rendering of complex XML documents into multiple output formats within content-based semantic architectures.
relaxngSkill: Structural validation and strict schema definition to ensure the integrity, format, and hierarchy of large volumes of XML data in document management systems and semantic CMS.
sshSkill: Secure remote server administration, public/private key configuration, deployments via encrypted tunnels, and fluent execution of operating system-level commands in production environments.
jenkinsSkill: Configuration and maintenance of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, automating test execution, artifact builds, and conditional deployments to ensure software quality.
scrumSkill: Cross-functional adoption of agile methodologies at both technical and team leadership levels, facilitating ceremonies, effort estimation, backlog prioritization, and iterative value delivery across development cycles (sprints).
illustratorSkill: Problem-solving ability in editing, scaling, and optimized exporting of vector graphics (SVG), iconography adaptation, and technical preparation of visual assets for direct implementation in the DOM.
photoshopSkill: Digital processing, optimized compression, and cropping of raster images, ensuring a balance between visual quality and web performance for seamless integration into digital environments.
fireworksSkill: Prior experience in rapid slicing and layout of web-oriented digital interfaces, high-fidelity prototyping, and efficient extraction of visual assets within classic design workflows.
flashSkill: Historical development of rich interactive experiences, custom multimedia players, and complete e-learning platforms through Object-Oriented Programming based on the ECMAScript standard.
inkscapeSkill: Functional use of open-source vector software for tracing, geometric manipulation, and generation of clean SVG graphics that are easily integrated into modern web architectures.
gimpSkill: Open-source alternative for the manipulation and technical optimization of bitmap images, color adjustments, and preparation of lightweight static resources for digital applications.

cccDescription:
Technical leadership across high-impact initiatives in specialized fields such as the pharmaceutical industry: advanced semantic search engines, real-time ticket management systems, and scientific document data-extraction tools generating instant medical reports from complex datasets.

Defining technical architecture, driving strategic business decisions, and leading a team to build robust, scalable web applications with a refined user experience.

Engineering solutions with Ember, integrating Redux for state management and d3 for interactive data visualizations, complemented by Tailwind/Sass styling, Scrum workflows, and automated testing with Jest and QUnit.
nttDataDescription:
Defining architectural guidelines, driving technical and business decisions, and leading teams to ensure excellence in delivering critical digital solutions at an institutional and European level.

Key engagements include initiatives for the European Patent Office (EPO), the MetAJob web platform connecting career counselors with job seekers, and backend development for a REST API Middleware within the iPasen educational ecosystem for the Regional Government of Andalusia.

Combining advanced technical architecture with people management and the integration of highly concurrent, secure services.
betixDescription:
Development of high-traffic ticketing web platforms for top-tier clients including FC Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atlético de Madrid, and El Corte Inglés, alongside other major sports organizations.

Engineering advanced interactive experiences through custom JavaScript libraries for 360-degree 3D stadium renders, complemented by the development of internal automation and rendering tools powered by Node.js and Python (Cinema 4D).

Managing web analytics strategy via Google Tag Manager (GTM) and Dynamic Tag Management (DTM), alongside performance testing and continuous optimization to handle massive traffic peaks reliably.
crealogixDescription:
Full lifecycle development, maintenance, and enhancement of web applications and enterprise portals for consumer brands, such as the Danone S.A. corporate portal and the Font Vella 'Eres Impulso' web app.

Technical implementation across frontend and backend, complex issue resolution, and continuous performance tuning to ensure operational stability.

Engineering workflow and repository administration on GitHub, code convention standardization, version control management, and technical documentation to ensure project scalability.
ximdexDescription:
Development and continuous enhancement of an XML-based semantic CMS tailored for advanced structured content management.

Implementation of core platform modules including XFIND, XOWL, XLYRE, and XRANK, along with web portal delivery for public and educational organizations such as the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), the BRAE platform, and the Open Ximdex Evolution corporate site.

Fullstack development, production deployments, automated testing, technical documentation, and direct technical support ensuring rapid issue resolution and high service reliability.
existoDescription:
End-to-end design and implementation of corporate portals and e-commerce stores across hospitality, telecom, and retail—delivering platforms for Grupo Hispasat, Mercer Hoteles Barcelona, and the Tramas + Malbatex online store.

Development and continuous improvement of e-conecta, the agency's proprietary CMS, delivering fullstack capabilities tailored to each client's content management requirements.

Dedicated technical support for the platform, production troubleshooting, and ongoing site maintenance to provide a reliable administrative experience.
freelanceDescription:
End-to-end development of the online student portal for the Andalusian Inter-University Institute of Criminology at the University of Seville.

Full project lifecycle coverage: architectural design, server-side logic (backend), and implementation of an intuitive, accessible web interface (frontend).

Direct stakeholder collaboration within the university environment to deliver a secure, functional solution aligned with academic standards.
gaesaDescription:
Development of e-learning platforms for students and interactive multimedia applications.

Implementation of frontend and backend web features, alongside the production of interactive training content using Adobe Flash and ActionScript 3.0.

Participation in digital education solutions for the Regional Government of Andalusia, ensuring accessible, interactive environments adapted to institutional pedagogical requirements.
